d: On July 29, 2019, VG Siddhartha, the Coffee King of India and founder of Café Coffee Day, took a day that would change everything. Without his usual two-car convoy, he left for Mangalore but unexpectedly instructed his driver to drop him off at a bridge, disappearing after walking away. When a missing report was filed, a troubling note revealed Siddhartha's struggles with mounting pressure and debt within his business empire. Despite running a seemingly successful brand with nearly 1,700 cafés, the reality was far bleaker. Siddhartha's past roots in coffee and stockbroking shaped his…
